items.title: Frank Murray Interview, 1960-05-12
items.q: P. Lala. Then she sang with Freddie Kepler...

ctx.x: And who all did she sing with?

Oh, Lord, I couldn't tell you who all she had in singing. Well, I mean here. In the city here. Joe Oliver, she sing with Joe Oliver at the, where did this man here at the nightclub down on Basin Street. I can't hear, he had a nightclub on Basin Street. And he moved his night, they moved his nightclub down to Claiborne Street. P. Lala. Then she sang with Freddie Kepler up at the Rosebud, or Rosebud's Theater. That was about the first colored theater here, with entertainment. The colored entertainers working down…
So she's had some good experience.
